formulas.name: Lorentz force
formulas.conditions: Classical charged-particle motion in the selected reference frame.

formulas.name: Maxwell equations
formulas.conditions: Use D=ε₀E and B=μ₀H in free space; material relations are cataloged separately.

formulas.name: Quasi-static condition
formulas.expression: T ≫ L/c, equivalently L ≪ λ = c/f
formulas.conditions: Source variation time is much longer than field travel time across the system.

formulas.name: Coulomb electric field
formulas.conditions: Static point charge Q in free space.

formulas.name: Electric-field superposition
formulas.conditions: Static point charges in a linear medium; the notes introduce this in free space.

formulas.name: Gauss law - integral form
formulas.conditions: Closed surface S bounds volume V.

formulas.name: Gauss law - differential form
formulas.conditions: Macroscopic D includes material polarization according to the material convention used later in the notes.

formulas.name: Infinite line-charge field
formulas.conditions: Infinite uniform line charge on the axis in free space.

formulas.name: Infinite sheet-charge field
formulas.conditions: Infinite uniform charge sheet in free space; direction is away from positive charge.

formulas.name: Cartesian divergence
formulas.conditions: Cartesian coordinates.

formulas.name: Cartesian curl
formulas.conditions: Cartesian coordinates.

formulas.name: Electrostatic field from potential
formulas.conditions: Electrostatic curl-free field.

formulas.name: Potential difference
formulas.conditions: Electrostatic field; path independent.

formulas.conditions: The final equality is for electrostatics where ∇×E=0.

formulas.name: Electrostatic boundary conditions
formulas.conditions: Static interface; ρ_s is free surface charge under the material convention.

formulas.name: Poisson equation
formulas.conditions: Homogeneous region with constant ε; use ε₀ for free space.

formulas.name: Laplace equation
formulas.conditions: Charge-free homogeneous region.

formulas.name: Potential from a volume charge distribution
formulas.conditions: Free-space electrostatic solution with sources localized in space.

formulas.name: Ohm law in a medium
formulas.conditions: Linear isotropic conduction model.

formulas.conditions: Long coaxial conductors with homogeneous dielectric, inner radius a and outer radius b.

formulas.expression: σ_s = N_s q_s²/(m_s ν_s); σ=Σ_s σ_s
formulas.conditions: Carrier species s with collision frequency ν_s.

formulas.name: Drude AC conductivity
formulas.conditions: Phasor steady state under the Drude collision model.

formulas.name: Polarization current density
formulas.conditions: Macroscopic polarization varying in time.

formulas.conditions: Magnetostatic filamentary current element.

formulas.conditions: Magnetostatics; I_C crosses a surface bounded by C.

formulas.name: Magnetostatic field equations
formulas.conditions: Static currents.

formulas.name: Infinite current-sheet field
formulas.conditions: Infinite uniform surface current; direction follows the right-hand rule.

formulas.name: Long-solenoid field
formulas.expression: H = nI ẑ; B = μnI ẑ
formulas.conditions: Long solenoid, approximately uniform interior field.

formulas.name: Magnetic vector potential
formulas.conditions: Magnetic field represented by a vector potential.

formulas.name: Vector-potential Poisson equation and solution
formulas.conditions: Magnetostatics in Coulomb gauge ∇·A=0.

formulas.name: Faraday law - differential form
formulas.conditions: Time-varying electromagnetic fields.

formulas.name: Generalized induced emf
formulas.conditions: Possibly moving contour C; v is local contour velocity in the measurement frame.

formulas.name: Inductance and induced voltage
formulas.conditions: Linear inductive structure with constant L; sign follows chosen passive/emf convention.

formulas.name: RL natural response
formulas.conditions: Source-free series RL loop with constant R and L.

formulas.conditions: Long solenoid, uniform core permeability and field.

formulas.name: Ampere-Maxwell law

formulas.conditions: D and H absorb bound-charge and bound-current effects.

formulas.name: Linear magnetic constitutive relation
formulas.conditions: Linear isotropic magnetic material.

formulas.name: Electromagnetic wave equation
formulas.conditions: Homogeneous source-free, nonconducting medium with constant μ and ε.

formulas.name: Plane TEM traveling wave
formulas.conditions: Homogeneous source-free medium; signs and transverse unit vectors must make E×H point along propagation.

formulas.name: Wave speed and intrinsic impedance
formulas.conditions: Homogeneous lossless medium.

formulas.name: Poynting vector
formulas.conditions: Instantaneous electromagnetic power-flow density.

formulas.conditions: Linear nondispersive medium under the derivation in the notes.

formulas.name: Time-average Poynting vector

formulas.name: Frequency, wavenumber, wavelength, and speed

formulas.name: Phasor Maxwell equations
formulas.conditions: Time dependence Re{phasor·e^{jωt}}.

formulas.conditions: Homogeneous linear conducting medium with e^{jωt} convention.

formulas.name: Damped TEM wave
formulas.conditions: Forward wave in +z; γ=α+jβ.

formulas.name: Penetration or skin depth
formulas.expression: δ = 1/α; for a good conductor δ≈1/√(πfμσ)
formulas.conditions: The second form uses the good-conductor approximation.

formulas.name: Circularly polarized electric field
formulas.conditions: Equal orthogonal component amplitudes in quadrature; sign determines handedness under the notes' convention.

formulas.name: Normal-incidence field coefficients
formulas.conditions: Normal incidence, no impressed surface charge/current at the planar interface; τ is the electric-field transmission coefficient.

formulas.name: Standing wave at a perfect conductor
formulas.conditions: Normally incident wave reflected from a PEC at z=0, with Γ=-1.

formulas.name: Lossless telegrapher equations
formulas.conditions: Lossless transmission line with per-unit-length L and C.

formulas.name: Parallel-plate transmission-line parameters
formulas.conditions: Wide parallel plates of separation d and width W; fringing neglected.

formulas.name: Lossless transmission-line speed and characteristic impedance
formulas.conditions: Lossless line.

formulas.name: Transmission-line traveling waves
formulas.conditions: A single forward or backward wave on a lossless line.

formulas.conditions: Real resistive load/source in the transient examples; use impedances in sinusoidal steady state.

formulas.name: Transmission-line junction coefficients
formulas.conditions: Wave incident from line j onto equivalent impedance Z_k.

formulas.name: Open-open or short-short line resonances
formulas.conditions: Lossless line with the same boundary type at both ends.

formulas.name: Open-short line resonances
formulas.conditions: Lossless line open at one end and shorted at the other.

formulas.name: Open and short stub input impedance
formulas.conditions: Lossless transmission-line stub.

formulas.name: Half-wave impedance repetition
formulas.conditions: Lossless line; repeats for integer multiples of λ/2.

formulas.name: Quarter-wave impedance transformation
formulas.conditions: Lossless quarter-wave section.

formulas.name: Load and generalized reflection coefficient
formulas.conditions: Lossless line, distance d measured from load toward generator as in the notes.

formulas.name: Line impedance-reflection transform
formulas.conditions: Transmission line with real positive Z₀ in the Smith Chart treatment.

formulas.name: Voltage standing-wave ratio
formulas.conditions: Lossless line.

formulas.name: Average power on a lossless line
formulas.conditions: Peak-value phasors and real Z₀.

formulas.conditions: Real positive load at the transformer location; a complex load must first be transformed to a real resistance.

formulas.name: Lossy telegrapher equations
formulas.conditions: Sinusoidal steady state with per-unit-length R, L, G, C.

formulas.name: Lossy-line propagation constant and characteristic impedance
formulas.conditions: Uniform transmission line in sinusoidal steady state.

formulas.conditions: ωL≫R and ωC≫G.
